panel.label: Salesforce ⇄ jCustomer Sync
panel.title: Salesforce ⇄ jCustomer Connector
panel.subtitle: Sync Contact, Account and Lead data from Salesforce into jCustomer profile properties.

connection.title: Salesforce Connection
connection.subtitle: Shared by both sync directions. The connector signs in to Salesforce with the JWT Bearer flow of a Connected App.

instanceUrl.label: Instance URL
instanceUrl.helper: Your My Domain URL, https only.

clientId.label: Client ID (Consumer Key)
clientId.placeholder: Consumer key of the Connected App
clientId.helper: Consumer key of the Connected App.

sfUsername.label: Salesforce API username
sfUsername.helper: Integration user, pre-authorized on the Connected App.

apiVersion.label: API version
apiVersion.hint: Leave empty to use {{version}} (sfdc.api.version in the OSGi configuration).

privateKey.label: Private key (PEM, PKCS#8)
privateKey.placeholderStored: A key is already stored - paste a new PEM to replace it
privateKey.stored: Private key stored - leave empty to keep it

connection.enabledHelp: When off, nothing is synced in either direction; settings are kept.

app.title: Connected App
app.description: The app and the integration user the connector signs in as.

key.title: Private key
key.description: Signs the sign-in requests. It is stored on the server and never shown again.

howTo.title: How to create the key and certificate
howTo.step1: 1. Generate an unencrypted PKCS#8 key: openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out key.pem
howTo.step2: 2. Create its certificate and upload it to the Connected App (Use digital signatures): openssl req -new -x509 -key key.pem -out cert.crt -days 3650
howTo.step3: 3. Paste the content of key.pem here. A PKCS#1 key (BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY) must be converted first: openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -in old.key -out key.pem

mapping.empty: No mappings configured. Click "Add mapping" to start.

export.csvTip: Download the {{obj}} field mapping as a CSV file
export.jsonTip: Download the {{obj}} field mapping as a JSON file

subtitle.inbound: For each Salesforce object, pick the field and the jCustomer property it fills. Profiles are matched by email.
subtitle.outbound: For each jCustomer property, pick the Salesforce field it fills. Records are matched by stored id, then email.

mapping.loadError: Some data could not be loaded
mapping.duplicatesHelp: Each target can receive one value: keep one row per target.

emptyMessage.inbound: Add a row to copy a Salesforce field into a jCustomer property.
emptyMessage.outbound: Add a row to send a jCustomer property to a Salesforce field.

sync.title: Last synchronisation
sync.subtitle: Monitor the last sync status.

triggers.title: Sync triggers
triggers.subtitle: Choose which events trigger a Salesforce data sync into jCustomer.

login.label: Login trigger
login.desc: Sync this user's SF data immediately on every Jahia login (OIDC, local). Runs asynchronously - login is not delayed.

scheduler.label: Scheduled batch
scheduler.desc: Sync all subscribed users on a cron schedule. Uses delta sync (LastModifiedDate filter).
scheduler.cronHint: Format: second minute hour day month weekday - e.g. 0 0 5 * * ? = daily at 05:00 UTC

manual.label: Manual sync
manual.desc: Full sync of all mapped contacts immediately (ignores lastSyncAt delta).

sync.started: Sync started in background. Refresh in a few seconds to see the result.
sync.info: The scheduled batch sync runs daily at 05:00 UTC. A login-triggered sync also fires automatically when a user logs in. Configure the schedule in the OSGi configuration file.

mapping.title: Outbound Field Mapping
mapping.subtitle: Map jCustomer profile properties to Salesforce Lead and Contact fields. Matched records are updated; unmatched profiles create a new one.
mapping.requiredHint: Salesforce requires {{fields}} to create a {{obj}} - map them, or only existing {{obj}} records will be updated.

triggers.title: Sync to Salesforce
triggers.subtitle: The connector polls jCustomer for changed profiles and pushes them to Salesforce as Leads.
triggers.pollStarted: Sync started in the background - check the last outbound run for results.

what.title: What to sync
what.subtitle: Turn on the changes to push to Salesforce automatically. jCustomer is polled on the schedule below while at least one is on; "Sync now" runs the same push immediately.

target.label: Target Salesforce object
target.desc: Push profiles to this object only. Configure its fields in the Mapping tab.

profileUpdate.label: Profile updates
profileUpdate.desc: Push profiles whose properties changed since the last run. An email is required to match or create the Lead.

formSubmission.label: Form submissions
formSubmission.desc: Push profiles that submitted a form since the last run.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: How often jCustomer is polled for changes while a trigger above is on.
schedule.active: Changes are pushed automatically on this schedule, starting from the moment a trigger was turned on.
schedule.inactive: No trigger is on: nothing is pushed automatically. Turn on Profile updates or Form submissions above.
schedule.usingDefault: Default schedule (outbound.poll.cron). Change it here to override.

auto.title: Automatic push
auto.description: Turn on a trigger and changed profiles are pushed on the schedule below.

now.title: Run now
now.description: Push immediately, without changing the configuration.

poll.label: Push the latest changes
poll.desc: Runs the same push as the schedule, right away.

push.label: Push one profile
push.desc: Sends one jCustomer profile, found by email, to a Salesforce {{object}}.

sync.title: Push to Salesforce
sync.subtitle: Push a jCustomer profile to a Salesforce Lead (matched by email; created if none exists). Event-based and scheduled pushes are configured separately.
sync.emailRequired: Enter a profile email to push.

result.skipped: {{email}} was not pushed: see History for the reason

describe.monthly: On day {{day}} of every month at {{time}}

history.subtitle: Each run and what it did. Expand a run to see who was synced and what changed. Polls that found no change are not recorded.
history.truncated: Details truncated: counts are complete, only the first records are kept.

purgeConfirm.inbound: Delete the whole SFDC to jCustomer sync history? This cannot be undone.
purgeConfirm.outbound: Delete the whole jCustomer to SFDC sync history? This cannot be undone.

started.inbound: Salesforce → jCustomer sync started in the background. Results appear in History.
started.outbound: jCustomer → Salesforce push started in the background. Results appear in History.

inbound.title: Salesforce → jCustomer
inbound.description: Salesforce Contact, Account and Lead data enriches jCustomer profiles.

outbound.title: jCustomer → Salesforce
outbound.description: jCustomer profiles create or update a Salesforce record.

notConfigured.title: The Salesforce connection is not configured
notConfigured.text: Enter the Connected App details and the private key to start syncing.

disabled.title: The connector is disabled
disabled.text: Nothing is synced in either direction until it is enabled.

testFailed.title: Salesforce cannot be reached with these settings

inboundNoMapping.title: Salesforce → jCustomer runs but maps no field
inboundNoMapping.text: Map Contact or Lead fields, or turn its triggers off.

outboundNoMapping.title: jCustomer → Salesforce runs but maps no {{object}} field
outboundNoMapping.text: Map the {{object}} fields to push, or turn its triggers off.

inboundErrors.text: Open the history to see who failed and why.
